Commentary.Commentary: The Super 12 group is now complete. Sri Lanka, Netherlands, Ireland and Zimbabwe all go through. It's time for more entertaining action. The big guns will be in action now. The host, Australia will take on New Zealand on 22nd October at 12.30 pm IST (7 am GMT) and then England will take on Afghanistan at 4.30 pm IST (11 am GMT). Join us early for the coverage. Cheers!

Craig Ervine says he cannot explain how it feels. Adds the players deserve this for the effort. Shares he wanted Sikandar Raza to play that kind of innings. Reckons they are looking forward to the next round. On the crowd, the support has been special and hopes the support follows all over Australia.

Richie Berrington, the skipper of Scotland says it's disappointing and he feels they were 25-30 runs short. They failed to get the momentum with the bat. Adds they are proud for the performance and there are a lot of positives to take away.

Sikandar Raza, the leading run scorer of the tournamrnt is the Player of the Match. He first starts by applauding the way Scotland played. Adds they bowled well and he knew someone had to turn up with the bat. Shares it was humbling and emotional to win. Tells he told Ervine to bat through and take the team home. Applauds and credits the support Zimbabwe gets all over the world.
...Presentation coming up...

A spirited fight showed by Scotland. Their new ball bowlers bowled brilliantly but as the game went on, as the dew came in, the wicket became easier and bowling got tough. In the second half of the chase, they could not stick to their plans and the execution wasn't there too. However, Scotland just did not have enough runs on the board. Zimbabwe were brilliant with the ball, they set it up for them by restricting Scotland to a low score and later on, chased it well. George Munsey was the lone fighter with the bat for Scotland but it was not enough.

The chase though in the end was quite comprehensive but the start wasn't that great. They lost two for not a lot. Craig Ervine and Sean Williams then tried to build a stand but Williams fell. Scotland were back in the mix but the stand between Ervine and Sikandar Raza took the game away. They counter-attacked and turned the tide into the favor of their side. Both fell but Burl and Shumba ensured it is Scotland who are going to take the flight back home.

Zimbabwe it is! Zimbabwe is the last team to ensure they progress in this tournament. They are the last side to book their birth in the major event. A clinical show from them to seal the deal. Celebration time for them. For West Indies and Scotland, their World Cup journey comes to an end.

FOUR! UP AND OVER! Zimbabwe celebrate! Sikandar Raza is pumped up! What a moment for Zimbabwe! On a length and outside off. Burl thumps it over the leaping mid on fielder for a boundary. ZIMBABWE WIN BY 5 WICKETS.
Short and on middle. Shumba plays the pull shot to deep square leg. One more. 4 needed now.
This is full and on off. Burl pushes it to mid off for another quick single.
Easy couple again! Touch short and on middle. Shumba punches it to long on for a couple. Zimbabwe are one hit away.
Full and on off. Burl drives to mid off for a quick single.
Short and outside off. Burl cuts it wide of deep point for a brace.
Outside off, flat. Shumba punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Quicker and on middle. Burl bunts it to square leg for a single. Singles will do for Zimbabwe. They do not want to do any silly things now.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to square leg for one.
Ryan Burl comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! Ervine goes now! The set-batter goes. Scotland still believe. Tossed up, full and outside off. Ervine tries to hit through the line as he lofts but doesn't power. Calum MacLeod at mid off tracks back and reverse-cups it. 14 runs needed in 18 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Calum MacLeod b Mark Watt

Commentary.Commentary: A single as this is hit to square leg.
Flatter, outside off and this one skids through. Shumba looks to cut but misses.
Short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Ervine dived for his life there! Around off. Shumba drops it to covers and calls for a quick single. Ervine runs across and luckily for him, the throw came wide of the keeper. A good throw and Ervine was well gone.
Tossed up, outside off. Kept out.
On the hips, nudged to square leg for one. 17 runs needed in 24 balls.
Outside off, played to third man for one.
FOUR! The good thing is the skipper is still out! He will look to take them to victory. This is full and outside off. Ervine drives it through covers for a boundary.
On a length and outside off. Shumba taps it to third man for one.
This is on the pads. Shumba helps it away to fine leg for a couple.
Outside off, driven through covers for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Raza goes! Is there a twist in the tale? A slower bouncer, Josh Davey rolls his finger on this one on middle. Raza looks to pull but gloves it to the keeper. The finger goes up and Raza walks without reviewing it. There was a big deflection. What a moment in the game. Zimbabwe need 27 runs in 30 balls. Scotland need 6 wickets.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Cross b Josh Davey

Commentary.Commentary: A slower ball on middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and on middle. Raza makes room and smashes it to long on for one.
FOUR! Another fine shot from Raza! Overpitched and going down the leg side. Raza sweeps it over square leg for a couple of bounces and four.
Fifty up for Ervine! A captain's knock but still the victory is away. 100 up as well. On middle, this is hit to deep square leg for a single.
This is full and outside off. Ervine swings hard but only to get a leading edge to third man for a couple of runs.
No ball! Length and outside off. Ervine drops it to point for a single. A free hit is coming up as Josh Davey overstepped.
This is down the leg side. Raza misses his flick. It looks like a desperate appeal as the Scotland players shout. They take the review. Ultra Edge shows nothing on it and Raza will continue.
FOUR! Sikandar Raza is in hurry now! This is full and outside off. Raza swings across, he splices and the ball goes over point for a boundary.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a couple. The stand moves to 50 now.
SIX! What a shot! Sikandar Raza only knows one way to play! This is a hard shot to play! Flat and outside off. Raza stays back and hammers it over covers for a biggie.
Touch short and outside off. Raza looks to sweep but misses. The ball bounces and hits him on the helmet. A precautionary concussion test will be followed now.
Flatter and outside off. Ervine slaps it to deep point for a single.
On middle, kept out.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler. The ball went flat but didn't carry. A single as it rolls away.
FOUR! Cleverly played! Short and outside off, slows it up. Ervine reverse hits and clears the infield and the ball goes to point for a boundary.
An arm ball. Raza punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and on off. Raza bunts to the right of the bowler.
Outside off, guided to point for a single.
SIX! Boundary just makes the over perfect for Zimbabwe. Tad short and outside off. Raza rocks back and pulls it all the way over mid-wicket for a biggie. 57 runs needed now in 48 balls.
Angles it around leg. Ervine makes room and taps it to point for a single.
On middle, this is hit to long on for one.
Flatter and outside off. Ervine punches it to long off for one.
On off. Raza eases it to mid on but for one.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
In the air but falls safely! Full and outside off. Raza looks to loft again. He slices and it goes to deep point. Drops in the vacant region for a brace.
On a length and on middle and leg. Ervine drills it to deep square leg for one.
Full ball, swinging on middle. Raza whips it to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Raza will play with the intent! This is full and outside off. Raza lofts it over covers. The fielder gives a chase but to no avail.
This is full and on middle, flicked to long on for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Raza taps it to third man for a single.

DRINKS! These two are the most important wicket for Scotland. If they get rid of them, they have a good chance to win. Raza though will not give away that easily. He has been the best batsman for Zimbabwe till now and will look to play another match-winning knock. Zimbabwe need 78 runs in 60 balls.
Three runs! Drops it short and on middle. Raza pulls it behind square leg. Michael Jones runs to his right, slides and makes a brilliant stop to save a single.
Ervine drives again to long off and rotates the strike.
Floated ball on middle. Raza pulls again to square leg for one.
Tossed up, outside off, pushed to long off for one. 50 up!
Touch short and around off, Raza pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Angling on the pads, worked to square leg for one.
A single to end the over as this is hit to long off.
Full and on off, eased to long off for one.
Sliding on middle. Raza nudges it to mid-wicket, close to the keeper. The keeper runs across but just when he tries to throw, he slips. Raza gets back in meantime.
A single as this is hit to long on.
Full and on off. Ervine flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
On middle. Defended.

OUT! TAKEN! Brad Wheal with an excellent catch! Sean Williams is livid with himself. This is dragged down and Sean Williams tries to pull this away. The ball goes to deep square leg where Brad Wheal runs in and plucks it right in front of him. Another timely wicket for Scotland and they are not giving away the game easily.
Commentary.Howout: c Brad Wheal b Michael Leask

Commentary.Commentary: Full and outside off, driven to long off for one.
Outside off, worked to point for one.
On middle, bunted to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! through the gap! This is full and around off. Ervine reverse hits it well through point, in the gap for four runs.
Leg bye! Flatter, quicker and on the pads. Sean Williams misses his tuck and it goes off the pads to point. A leg bye.
Michael Leask is into the attack.
Four singles off the over then! Zimbabwe are happy to nudge around! That is the need of the hour. They are hitting the loose balls away. On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for one.
Slower in the air, outside off. Ervine bunts it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Mark Watt gets it to swing in, short and outside off. Ervine slaps it to cover.
Just sliding down on the fuller side. Ervine looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Full, quicker and on middle. Sean Williams flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter ball, outside off. Ervine punches it to point for a quick single.
Mark Watt to bowl now.
Another single as this time Ervine plays it to third man. End of the Powerplay, Zimbabwe are 30/2. 103 runs needed in 84 balls.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Very full and on middle. Sean Williams whips but finds short fine leg.
Length and on middle. Ervine closes the face of the bat too early and it goes off the leading edge to third man for one.
On middle, this is hit to square leg.
SHARP SINGLE! On off, nudged to mid-wicket for one.
Length and on off. Ervine dabs it to backward point.
This one seams back in, length and on middle. Ervine is cramped up but does well to keep it out.
FOUR! Two in a row! Much better shot from the captain! Pitched up again. Ervine drives it straight down past mid off for four.
FOUR! Well played! Pitched up, outside off. Ervine drives it through covers, beats the fielder for a boundary.
On a length and around off. Craig Ervine gets inside the line and flicks it to mid on.
This is full and on off. Williams drives it to mid off for a quick single.
This one is on a length and angling across, outside off. Craig Ervine looks to drive but misses.
Short of a length and around off. Craig Ervine punches it back to the bowler.
Tad short and on middle. Blocked out.
Short in length and on middle. Williams pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
On the hips, clipped through square leg for one more.
Length and on middle. Craig Ervine mistimes his pull to mid on. Just one.
FOUR! Not a good start! Straight on the pads. Craig Ervine flicks it past square leg for a boundary. More trouble as Safyaan Sharif has overstepped. A free-hit to follow.
Safyaan Sharif to bowl now.
Craig Ervine uses the pace and dabs it to third man for a single.
This is full and on middle. Craig drives it back to the bowler.
On a length and on middle. Ervine fends it away.
On the pads, this is flicked past square leg for a couple of runs.
Length and on top of off. Ervine guides it to backward point.
This is outside off. Ervine leaves it alone.
Outside off, on a length, punched to mid off. Successful over for Scotland.
Length and on off. Sean Williams blocks it out.
Sean Williams is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Two in two overs for Zimbabwe! Another low score for Wesley Madhevere! This is full and way outside off. Wesley Madhevere looks to drive but gets an inside edge and it hits the stumps. Unfortunate dismiss but Scotland won't mind.
Full and outside off, pushed to mid off.

Leg bye! Short of a length and outside off. Ervine steps across and taps it to backward point. The batters take a quick single. There is a direct hit at the keeper's end but Ervine has his bat grounded. Not out it is.
On a length and on middle. Craig Ervine flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. He is off the mark.
Josh Davey to bowl from the other end.
Short inn length and tailing on leg. Madhevere keeps it out. Just the start Scotland wanted.
This is full and outside off. Madhevere drives it to cover.
On a length and outside off. Wesley Madhevere blocks it out.
Wesley Madhevere comes in.

OUT! LBW! A perfect start for Scotland! A big break through as Regis Chakabva could have been very dangerous. This is on a length and around off, extra bounce on offer. Regis Chakabva gets on his toes as he looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An LBW appeal and up goes the finger. That looked very close but Regis Chakabva takes the review. Ultra Edge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows umpire's call on wickets hitting and Regis Chakabva has to go back.
FOUR! Zimbabwe are off the mark. Short of a length and outside off. Regis Chakabva pulls it nice and to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length and outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to push softly but misses.
